About the Firm

Technically Grounded IP Advisory

Headquartered in Coimbatore, serving academic research scholars, university R&D cells, startups, and industrial technical leads.

Who We Are: BREVETT IP SOLUTIONS is an India-based intellectual property and innovation-support enterprise. We help clients understand the patent implications of their research, organize technical data into enforceable disclosures, and make sound commercialization decisions.
Our Vision

Democratizing Responsible Protection

To make rigorous, responsible intellectual property protection accessible to researchers and technical founders across academia and industry.

Our Mission

Grounded Research & Dependable Support

To deliver technically sound IP research, clear documentation, transparent engagement, and dependable support while respecting strict confidentiality.

Engagement Process

6-Step Workflow

A transparent pathway from preliminary non-confidential discovery to verified deliverables.

01

Initial Enquiry

Share a brief non-confidential description of your technical field and objectives.

02

NDA & Scoping

Execute mutual confidentiality arrangements and clearly define scope of work.

03

Deep-Dive

Discuss the invention, available experimental data, embodiments, and deadlines.

04

Proposal

Receive a transparent written scope, deliverables, timeline, and professional fees.

05

Execution

We perform agreed research and communicate search findings and technical matrices.

06

Deliverables

Receive completed reports and a clear route to separately engaged patent agent services.
